title: pleopeltis cochlearis
intro: Pleopeltis cochlearis, commonly known as the earleaf polypody, is a species of epiphytic fern native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pleopeltis cochlearis include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been studied for their potential to inhibit cancer cell growth and protect against oxidative stress.
